faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Atal Awasiya Vidyalaya Bareilly Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application form for the Atal Awasiya Vidyalaya Bareilly Recruitment 2026 is 24 September 2026. Ensure your application reaches the specified address before this date.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for PGT and TGT posts?
faq.answer: There are a total of 12 vacancies for PGT and TGT posts announced by Atal Awasiya Vidyalaya Bareilly. These vacancies are distributed across various subjects as detailed in the official notification.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for PGT posts?
faq.answer: For PGT posts, candidates must possess a Master's Degree with at least 50% marks in the relevant subject and a B.Ed. degree (minimum 50% marks) from an NCTE recognized institution.

faq.question: Q4. What are the eligibility criteria for TGT posts?
faq.answer: TGT posts require a Bachelor's Degree with a minimum of 50% marks in the concerned subject, a B.Ed. degree (minimum 50% marks), and a qualified CTET/UPTET Paper-II.

faq.question: Q5. What is the maximum age limit for the applicants?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all applicants is 50 years as of 01 July 2026. Age relaxation will be provided as per government norms.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for PGT and TGT positions?
faq.answer: PGT posts offer a salary of ₹ 35,750.00 per month, while TGT posts offer ₹ 34,125.00 per month. These are contractual positions.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive by Atal Awasiya Vidyalaya Bareilly.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process for the PGT and TGT posts at Atal Awasiya Vidyalaya Bareilly will be based on an interview. Candidates shortlisted after the initial screening will be called for the interview.

faq.question: Q9. In which mode should the application be submitted?
faq.answer: Applications for this recruitment must be submitted in offline mode. Candidates need to download the application form, fill it, and send it via post to the address mentioned in the official notification.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and application form can be downloaded from the official website of Atal Awasiya Vidyalaya Bareilly, which is bareilly.nic.in. Ensure you download the correct documents from the official source.
